issues.claim: founder_md, Open questions: 'Birdeye and Salon Lookup show (732) 305-6557'.
issues.problem: The Birdeye page for this business shows no phone number at all. Opening https://reviews.birdeye.com/salon-g-and-spa-169813247044904 in Chrome returns rating, 117 reviews, hours, address and 'Claim this profile'; searching the page source finds neither 305-6557 nor 410-7951. The (732) 305-6557 number is attributed to Birdeye without support. The rest of that sentence (Google profile shows (732) 410-7951) is correct.
issues.fix: Reword to what the sources show, e.g. 'the profile shows (732) 410-7951, while Salon Lookup and other directories show (732) 305-6557; Birdeye lists no phone'. No change needed in audit_md.

issues.claim: audit_md: '4.5 from 117 reviews' presented as one Google profile fact.
issues.problem: The 4.5 rating is confirmed on the Google place page, but Google served a 'limited view' with no review count, so 117 is not visible there. 117 appears on the Birdeye mirror of the same business, which shows 4.7 stars with 117 reviews - rating and count come from two sources with different averages.
issues.fix: Either drop the count ('4.5-star rated') or say '117 reviews, per the Birdeye mirror (4.7 there)'. Nothing else in the report depends on the number.
